subject.title: [bug]：Gateway pairing failure on Trim OS / TerraMaster NAS: WebSocket closes with code 1002 during device proof response

question: What supported recovery path should OpenClaw offer for Trim OS local clients that hit Gateway pairing close code 1002 while preserving the Gateway device-auth boundary?
rationale: The remaining choices affect authentication behavior and may involve a package manager outside this repository, so automation should not infer a bypass, config rewrite policy, or protocol compatibility exception without maintainer intent.

options.title: Request live protocol evidence first
options.body: Ask for a redacted connect frame, Gateway logs around the 1002, and exact CLI/Gateway/package versions before choosing a code or packaging repair.

options.title: Repair package-owned config regeneration
options.body: If logs show the protocol is correct but Trim OS rewrites auth/config unexpectedly, route the fix to the app package or installer owner rather than weakening Gateway auth.

options.title: Design an explicit local-only trust mode
options.body: If maintainers want a new loopback recovery path, define it as a deliberate security-reviewed mode with docs, upgrade behavior, and tests.

recommendation.title: Request live protocol evidence first
recommendation.body: Ask for a redacted connect frame, Gateway logs around the 1002, and exact CLI/Gateway/package versions before choosing a code or packaging repair.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter Steinberger has the strongest local history across Gateway handshake helpers, device approval CLI, and related docs.
